metaData.title: Ozark Valley Arts Council finance sync check in

sentences.text: Morning. This is the finance session we agreed when you came across in the spring, so it is the first proper one.
Morning. Six months in feels about right for a first proper one.
How has the month end been running since the summer?
Smoothly for the most part, and I want to say that first because the rest of what I have is a complaint.
The close takes three days now rather than the eight it took on the old system, and nobody here misses the old system.
Three days from eight is a real change. Now tell me the complaint.
The month end posting has come through twice into our ledger on three closings since the spring, and our treasurer reverses the copy by hand each time.
It is always the same shape. One batch arrives, and then some minutes later the identical batch arrives again with its own reference.
May, July and August. June was clean and September is not closed yet, so I am holding my breath.
Reversing it is perhaps forty minutes of work, but the worry beforehand costs more than the forty minutes does.
What does the worry actually look like in practice?
Our treasurer checks the ledger line by line on the first morning after every close, because he no longer trusts it to be right.
That is a volunteer with a full time job giving us two hours he should not have to give.
Do you have the reference numbers from the three occasions?
I have all six, three originals and three copies, and I can send them over within the hour.
Send them and I will get them in front of the right people today with the dates attached.
Thank you. The other thing on my list is the audit, which is in February and is our first under the new arrangement.
Have the auditors told you what they will want to see?
The usual list, and they have asked for a walkthrough of the close in January before the fieldwork begins.
That is a meeting about process rather than anything technical, so I do not think I need anything from you for it.
Say the word if that changes. I would rather sit in an unnecessary meeting than miss a necessary one.
Noted, and I may take you up on it in January once I know what they are actually asking for.
One action for me then, the duplicate postings with your six references.
Anything else before we stop?
That is everything. The references will be with you before lunch.
